blocks.text: MANILA – The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) is urging Catholics to join an overnight prayer vigil in Manila marking the culmination of a pilgrimage of the image of Our Lady of Guadalupe. The Church will hold the closing celebration at the Quirino Grandstand in Manila on December 11 to 12. In a letter dated November CBCP president Archbishop Gilbert Garcera of Lipa called on dioceses, parishes, religious communities, and Catholic institutions to mobilize the faithful for the gathering.
